_doc: Drive 9: the combined build (routes F3 mass + F2 head + the figure-pose lane's appeal poses and bust + route F1's painterly finish, re-tuned). Read by tools/pixel-pipeline/drive9/ (bl_build.py 'build', d9_blender.py 'head' and 'shots', d9_post.py 'finish'). Never overwrites integrated.json; nothing here is promoted to rosace.blend. 'why' gives the reason for each pick.

why.build: Route F3 pick L (ref-14 bells, mid tabard with pipe folds, hair volume): two of three finish-route judges kept it for mass. Idle mass 0.264 at 144 / 0.277 at 80 in the combined stills (current 0.229 / 0.244). The judges split on the near bell's dark lining lobe at the hip; a side-by-side with the bell hanging (drape idle=none) looked almost the same, because the lobe is the bigger bell itself. Kept, and the lining got a 7-step ramp with strand texture so it reads as cloth, not a flat navy fill.
why.bust: shape.json 'current' (S7), read from the figure-pose lane at build time. The bust fix is shading, not size (the judges' note): d9_post.py 'bust' puts a cleavage wedge where the bodice normal flips, an underbust shadow and a darker underside.
why.head: 1.10 (route F2 H110E, with the bigger 144 px eye stamps). The judges asked for 1.15-1.20 toward '1/6 of height, 24-25 px'. Measured on these stills (hair top to chin / hair top to sole), H110 is already 0.195 (27.6 px) on the idle and H115 is 0.201: every ref measures 0.14-0.20 (finish-gap.md 2.5), so 1/6 would mean a smaller head than now. F2's blind set put H115E next to last and H120E last. By eye on the combined build (work/c_face_h110_h115.png), H115 gains nothing at 144 or 80.
why.poses: The figure-pose lane's newest idle_appeal.json (a89be9fabdd7) and back_appeal.json (d65ee47e75d8), concept A 'queen contrapposto', through its own applier (read-only); n1_contact and q_stamp are the canonical poses. Route F3's drape patch p5 is merged at render time. The stance fix (wider feet, free knee out) belongs to the figure-pose lane and isn't done here.
why.finish: Route F1's method (a 4x render, then painterly ramps, texture, interior AA, an adaptive palette and selective lines), re-tuned per the judges: ramps hue-shifted around the current colour anchors, darks pushed low-key (gamma), 6-10 tones per material plus AA in-betweens (no 32-colour cap), a dark line all round light shapes, a 1 px rim, a skin ramp with a narrow red terminator and a clean face, soft blush, glossy stockings, a hair angel ring, cleavage and underbust. The ramps live in drive9/d9_finish.json; everything runs in numpy on our own passes (no image generation).
why.thong: 1 px, the line colour #16131d, via f1_post.thong (DESIGN 3.5 item 5). The model string is thicker; the pixel pass thins it.

round2._doc: Whole-character round 2 on drive 9 (PIPELINE 3.6n): the round-1 critics' fixes plus ESCALATION 1, as render-time patches and a finish overlay. The round-1 picks above are unchanged; nothing is baked into lanes/drive9.blend or rosace.blend.

head.why: ESCALATION 1 names head and eye scale, but the round-1 face and body critics measured the head at about 1/5 of height, at or above the refs' 1/6, and said 'do not spend the next round on head scale'; route F2's blind set had H115 next to last. H113 was rendered (raw/R2_H113, idle) and gains nothing by eye at 144 or 80. Pulled back: 1.10 kept, the eye stamps got smaller irises under a lower lid instead.

why.tabard: Critics (first impression, body, outfit): the pelvis read as one skin block with a 1 px string ('bottomless'), and the thin pointed tabard read as a sword. The design's front tabard is meant to cover the front (DESIGN table: 'covers the front, main flag'): widened x1.3 at the waist to x1.65 at the hem (a flare, silhouette mass) and hung straight (idle tabard g 1.0, no side wind), so it covers the crotch at 144 and 80.
why.circlet: Critic (head and hair): 'no signature priestess head piece; the side beads are tiny; add a gold circlet, rosace pin or short veil that reads at 80'. A gold front diadem on the hair's own contour at the brow (front 1.775 m, back 1.845 m, 160 deg arc whose ends sink into the hair) with a glass rosace jewel at the centre. A full ring read as a hat brim; a band 0.02 m tall drew as outline only.
why.idle: Pose angles +30 % over the figure-pose lane's concept A (ESCALATION 1): hip rotation 5/15/4 -> 6.5/19.5/5.2, torso bend -12/-5 -> -15.6/-6.5, upper chest lift 6 -> 8, head tilt 12 -> 16 and chin 7 -> 10 (critic: 'tilt 6-8 deg chin down, knowing look'). The near bell sleeve is scaled 0.78 and blown back (g 0.5) so the waist-to-hip curve breaks the silhouette (critic: 'clear the sleeve off the hip'). The free knee's pole moves out-forward (the stance note: 'idle knees cross inward').
why.back: Critic: 'not a back view: a near-frontal face'. The look amount 1.0 -> 0.62 with max 85 -> 60: the head turns over the shoulder to three-quarter (head facing the camera 0.78 -> 0.44), and d9_post draws one profile eye when the far eye faces away (r2_faces.json profile_below).
why.q: Critic (first impression): 'the q crouch reads as a broken hip / a fall at 80'. The kicked-up rear leg drops into a driving back lunge (foot 0.64 -> 0.32 m high, knee pole down) and the camera turns 50 -> 35 deg so the rear leg reads behind her instead of splayed sideways. The stamp itself (planted glaive, front heel) is unchanged.
why.hand: Critics (body 6, grip 8): 'the free hand is a clump at the sternum; move it to the hip, back of the wrist on the hip bone, elbow out'. The figure-pose lane's rest-frame wrist [-0.15, 0, 1.22] lands in front of the belly in the 45 deg view, under the cuff. Moved to [-0.21, 0.09, 1.10] (out, back and down onto the side of the hip) with the elbow pole out-back [-0.9, 1.0, 1.3]: the hand now sits on the silhouette's hip with the forearm and waist framing a gap (trials r2_vd / r2_ve, ve kept).

head.why: Body critic (round 2): 'the head is about 1/5 of her height over a short ribcage; bring the head toward 1/5.5'; face critic: 'widen the hair mass so the face reads smaller'. With the hair volume x1.12 at the crown, head x1.05 against x1.10 looks nearly the same by eye (trial r3_t3), and head / H on the idle goes 0.196 -> 0.190 (back 0.187 -> 0.181).

why.face: FC-P36 changed: the eye as a lid wedge (flick + two rows over the outer third) with an A2 band and a 2x2 pupil over a desaturated but light iris; every shot takes the open eye, n1 a set line mouth, Q a small symmetric open mouth. FC-P38: the neck's cast shadow, a jaw step and a drawn 2 px blush. The first eye (a full two-row lash on a dark navy iris) read as a sleepy slab and was lightened.
why.back: FC-P37 changed: look amount 0.62 -> 0.75 (0.85 read near-frontal), the turned face lifted (face lift 0.56), the back hair and tail blown to the far side.
why.hair: HR-P26: an authored sheen arc from the crown's own top edge, a fringe cut at 4 unequal places from an off-centre parting, a 3-step azure tip taper, flyaways launched along the silhouette's downward tangent; hair volume x1.12 at the crown.
why.finish: PX-P46: the rim on the outline pixel (the inset rim is off). PX-P47: noise blurred to clusters and a despeckle pass; no haft texture. Whites capped at #e3dfe5, OKLab chroma x0.75-0.85. CL-P23: a sheer stocking against an opaque, bluer boot.
why.body: Idle: spine side tilt -26 (opposing shoulders), chest and upper-chest lift, the hip-hand elbow pole out-back, the glaive hand 9 cm up the haft. Bust: the cleavage wedge only under the neckline, the lit side of the bust lifted toward the white ramp's 0.8 tone, one 4 px highlight on the lit apex (the 'two grey spheres' fix). Skin beside the tabard takes an occlusion step.
why.q: PS-P31: the kicked rear leg planted behind the front leg, hips 7 cm higher, the glaive tilted about 10 degrees off her face; a 25 degree tilt left both hands off the haft.
why.fx: PX-P48: N1 (contact f9, the leaded stage) takes the blade's swept glass fan about the rear fist with A0 leading and a G1 sliver; Q takes a glass flash and a leaded floor crack at the butt (MOVESET Q5). A thin crescent read as a scythe blade.

why.circlet: Removed. Face critic (round 3): 'the gold diadem sits on the brow line, so the eyes are pinned under a heavy gold bar'; 'the control proves the bare fringe reads better'.
why.hair: Crown x1.03 rising to x1.10 from the ear line down (round 3: x1.12 at the crown): 'cut the crown back to 1.0-1.05 and put the volume into the sides and ends' (HR-P27).
why.idle: Round 2's idle torso and arms on the pose file's own legs (the control's lambda), head tilt 9 / chin 5 (was 16 / 10), the waist stretched (spine x1.14 along its length, chest counter-scaled): body critic 'best composite: R2 idle torso and arms + control legs'; 'lengthen the ribcage 1-2 px'.
why.back: The pose file's own look (amount 1.0, max 85; the control's framing), the near bell x0.72 blown forward, the hair to the far side (round 3): 'the control back is the one to copy'.
why.q: Round 2's kick with round 3's glaive direction +0.18 (the pose file's direction ran the haft through her face): 'replace q with D's kick'.
why.finish: Rim only on convex peaks (3 px, warm #f0dcc6; PX-P46 changed); the white ramp's top warm near-white with a lavender core and bounce 0.10; hair gamma 1.35, stocking gamma 1.3; the bust lift 0.35 and underside 0.5; ramp_soften puts one in-between tone at every 2+ rank step inside a material.
why.paint: ESCALATION 2 (WF-P20): per still and size, the face (FC-P39: an almond eye with one lash row and a flick, a 3-row dark-to-light iris with a catchlight, cool white, blush, an asymmetric smile on idle and back, set brows and a shout on Q, a set mouth on N1), the idle fringe as 6 tapered locks and the idle 80 as 4 (HR-P27; gaps only on the back glance), loose strands off the outline, pipe folds on the tabard and bells, a lit ridge on the far bell's lining, a stocking sheen stripe, the spine on the back, and the near chest repainted as a side plane (PS-N24).
